patientRequestRecorded.en: Your request has been recorded for processing.
patientRequestRecorded.translation: E dekọọla arịrịọ gị ka e wee rụọ ọrụ na ya.

patientAwaitingReview.en: Your information has been saved for review by the care team.
patientAwaitingReview.translation: E chekwala ozi gị ka ndị nlekọta nyochaa ya.

patientNoCallSummary.en: No clinical summary has been recorded for this call.
patientNoCallSummary.translation: E dekọbeghị nchịkọta ahụike maka oku a.

welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: Ka anyị kwadebe gị maka nleta gị.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Zaa ajụjụ ole na ole gbasara mgbaàmà gị. Dọkịta gị ga-enyocha ihe niile tupu unu ezute.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Nke a na-ejikọta nleta gị na ndekọ gị.

placeholderComplaint.translation: Kọwaa mgbaàmà kacha enye gị nsogbu…

interviewLoadError.translation: Anyị enweghị ike ibunye ajụjụ gị.

interviewComplete.en: Thanks, {name}. I have what I need. Let's review your answers before sending them to the doctor.
interviewComplete.translation: Daalụ, {name}. Enwetala m ihe m chọrọ. Ka anyị nyochaa azịza gị tupu izigara dọkịta ha.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Daalụ — aga m ajụ ajụjụ ole na ole gbasara {complaint} gị. Olee mgbe ọ malitere?

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Daalụ — aga m ajụ ajụjụ ole na ole gbasara ihe wetara gị. Olee mgbe ọ malitere?

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Dee azịza, ma ọ bụ pịa ntụnye dị n'elu

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Pịa ihe ọ bụla iji dozie ya tupu iziga.

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Ọ bụrụ na mgbaàmà gị dị njọ ma ọ bụ na-akawanye njọ ugbu a, echela — kpọọ ndị ọrụ mberede.

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Mgbaàmà gị na-egosi na ọ dị mkpa ka a hụ gị ngwa ngwa. Anyị egosila ndị nlekọta na okwu gị chọrọ nlebara anya ngwa ngwa.

urgencyStep1Title.translation: A na-eziga nchịkọta gị ugbu a

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Ndị nlekọta ga-anata akụkọ ahụike gị ozugbo.

urgencyStep2Title.translation: Ka a hụ gị n'ime awa 1–2

urgencyStep2Desc.en: Based on {level} urgency. You will be notified when a clinician opens it.
urgencyStep2Desc.translation: Dabere na ogo mberede {level}. A ga-agwa gị mgbe onye ọrụ ahụike meghere ya.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Ọ bụrụ na ọ kawanye njọ, mee ngwa ngwa

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị njọ ma ọ bụ na ọ kawanye njọ na mberede — kpọọ ndị ọrụ mberede ozugbo.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Nke a bụ atụmatụ ogo mberede nke igwe, ọ bụghị nchọpụta ọrịa. Onye ọrụ ahụike ga-eme mkpebi ikpeazụ.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: A hụla gị n'ụlọ ọgwụ a tupu ugbu a. Ka anyị ziga nchịkọta gị ozugbo ebe ahụ?

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Ha enweelarị ndekọ gị, ya mere ndị nlekọta ga-ahụ akụkọ gị niile ozugbo.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?
findSearchTitle.translation: Ebee ka ịchọrọ ka a hụ gị?

findSearchSubtitle.en: Pick a Triavi hospital near you — your {level} brief is sent the moment you choose.
findSearchSubtitle.translation: Họrọ ụlọ ọgwụ Triavi dị gị nso — a ga-eziga nchịkọta ogo {level} gị ozugbo ị họrọ.

findScanning.translation: A na-achọ ụlọ ọgwụ Triavi dị gị nso…

findSortedByDistance.translation: · a haziri ha site n'ebe dị nso

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Anyị enweghị ike ịchọta ebe ị nọ. Pịa ịchọ ọzọ ka ị nwaa.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Nchịkọta gị dị n'aka ndị nlekọta. Anyị ga-agwa gị ozugbo onye ọrụ ahụike meghere ya.

timelineOpened.translation: Onye ọrụ ahụike emeghela nchịkọta gị

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-akawanye njọ, mee ihe ugbu a

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Echela oge gị n'ahịrị. Ọ bụrụ na mgbaàmà gị dị njọ ma ọ bụ na-akawanye njọ na mberede — kpọọ ndị ọrụ mberede ugbu a ma ọ bụ gaa ngalaba mberede kacha dị nso.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Anyị ebuliwo mkpa okwu gị ka ndị nlekọta mara.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Onye ọrụ ahụike na-enyocha nchịkọta gị. Anyị ga-agwa gị otú ọ na-aga.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Zaa ajụjụ ole na ole gbasara otú ahụ dị gị kemgbe nleta gị.

checkinTrendSame.translation: Ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ dị otú ọ dị

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Kedu ka ọnọdụ gị dị ma e jiri ya tụnyere nke mbụ?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Ọ dị ihe ọzọ ịchọrọ ịgwa anyị?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Obi dị anyị ụtọ na ahụ adịla gị mma

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: Anyị ga-elele gị ọzọ {next} iji hụ na ị ka na-akawanye mma.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today
checkinResultReview.translation: Onye ọrụ ahụike ga-elele nke a taa

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: E zigala azịza gị nye ndị nlekọta. Onye ọrụ ahụike ga-enyocha ha ma kpọtụrụ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Mgbaàmà gị na-egosi na ị chọrọ nlebara anya ngwa ngwa. Echela — kpọtụrụ ndị nlekọta gị ma ọ bụ gaa ngalaba mberede kacha dị nso.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Nlekọta sochirinụ a adịghịzi. Banye ka ị hụ ndebanye gị ndị dị ugbu a.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: E kwenyela ndebanye gị. Mepụta akaụntụ efu iji soro nleta a ma gafee koodu oge ọzọ.

authVerifyTitle.translation: Ka anyị chọpụta na ọ bụ gị

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Anyị ga-eziga koodu a na-eji otu ugboro — enweghị okwuntughe ị ga-echeta.

authSecuredBy.translation: Triavi na-echebe ya · Ọ na-agbaso HIPAA

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: E zigara na {dest}. Ọ ga-agwụ n'ime nkeji 10.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Tinye ekwentị ma ọ bụ ozi ịntanetị gị, anyị ga-eziga koodu ịbanye.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Akaụntụ gị jikọtara na ndekọ ụlọ ọgwụ gị

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)
errInvalidPhone.translation: Tinye nọmba ekwentị ziri ezi (mkpụrụ nọmba 7–14)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Enweghị ike iziga koodu. Nwaa ọzọ.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Nsogbu netwọkụ. Lelee njikọ gị ma nwaa ọzọ.

errResendFailed.translation: Enweghị ike iziga ọzọ. Nwaa ọzọ.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Maka nchekwa gị na ozi ndị ọrịa, e wepụla gị mgbe ị nọchara oge na-ejighị ngwa a.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Malite ndebanye iji malite nleta ọhụrụ.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Oku nlekọta na-akụ n'ngwa a · a naghị ekekọrịta nọmba ekwentị gị.

dashSimulateCall.translation: Nwaa oku nlekọta na-abata · ihe ngosi

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Họrọ onye ga-akpọ gị na otú olu ya ga-adị.

toneWarmDesc.translation: Ọ na-eme ka obi ruo ala, ọ naghị eme ngwa ngwa

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Ọ na-ekwu kpọmkwem, enweghị okwu ọzọ

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Nnọọ Jordan, oge ọgwụ mgbede gị eruola…

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Kpọọ n'oge ọgwụ ọ bụla e debere

postVisitCallsDesc.translation: “Kedu ka ahụ dị gị?” mgbe ịpụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Enweghị oku site 9:30 abalị ruo 7:30 ụtụtụ · a ga-eziga ọkwa kama

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Ahịrị nlekọta gị ka na-arụ ọrụ — banye ọzọ iji hazie oku na ncheta.

callRingVerified.translation: E nyochaala · site n'ahịrị nlekọta gị {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Oku olu echekwara · WebRTC · a naghị ekekọrịta nọmba gị

callAriaMute.translation: Gbanye ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ igwe okwu

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Naanị gị na {hospital} nwere ike ịhụ ndị a. Pịa nleta iji gụọ nchịkọta e nyere gị.

visitDetailMeds.translation: ỌGWỤ E DERE KA Ị ṄỤỌ

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Enweghị oku nlekọta maka nleta a.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Nke a bụ nchịkọta e nyere gị — ọ bụghị nchọpụta ọrịa. Ọ bụrụ na mgbaàmà gị alọghachi ma ọ bụ kawanye njọ, chọọ nlekọta mberede ozugbo.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Enwere ike iwepụ nleta a, ma ọ bụ njikọ ahụ adịghịzi mma. Laghachi ịhụ akụkọ gị niile.

visitDetailBackToVisits.translation: Laghachi na nleta ndị gara aga

visitDetailDischargeBadge.translation: Ndị nlekọta gị ekweela ka ị laa

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Melite nkọwa gị. Dọkịta gị ga-ahụ nke ọhụrụ.

placeholderEmergencyName.translation: Aha onye a ga-akpọ na mberede

placeholderEmergencyRelation.translation: Dịka: di, nwunye, nne ma ọ bụ nna

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Ọ na-agbanwe asụsụ ihuenyo niile ozugbo.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Enweghị ike idetuo — họrọ ma detuo n'onwe gị

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Ihe anyị na-echebe na ihe ị na-achịkwa.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: A na-ewepụ aha gị, nkọwa kọntaktị na azịza ị dere tupu ihe ọ bụla apụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ gị. Naanị ndị nlekọta gị na-ahụ ozi nke na-egosi onye ị bụ; nchọpụta na nyocha na-ahụ naanị ozi e wepụrụ njirimara ya.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Kwe ka e jiri ozi na-enweghị njirimara melite nlekọta onye ọ bụla. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe nke a mgbe ọ bụla.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Ncheta oge nleta na ndebanye nlekọta sochirinụ site na oku ma ọ bụ ọkwa. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe nke a mgbe ọ bụla.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Wepụ akaụntụ na nkọwa kọntaktị gị kpamkpam. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-edobe akụkọ ahịrị nlekọta gị dịka iwu chọrọ.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Rịọ nnomi nchịkọta nleta, ọgwụ na akụkọ oku nlekọta gị.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Nke a na-ewepụ akaụntụ na nkọwa kọntaktị gị kpamkpam. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-edobe akụkọ ahịrị nlekọta gị dịka iwu chọrọ. Enweghị ike ịkagbu nke a.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Ndị nlekọta gị ga-akwado site n'ozi ịntanetị n'ime awa 72. Ahịrị nlekọta gị ga-arụ ọrụ ruo mgbe ahụ.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Họrọ ụdị faịlụ ma rịọ ndekọ gị. Anyị ga-akwadebe ya ma ziga njikọ echekwara na ozi ịntanetị i debanyere.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Anyị ga-eziga njikọ echekwara na ozi ịntanetị i debanyere n'ime awa 24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: A naghị ebudata faịlụ ebe a — a na-eziga ndekọ gị n'ụzọ echekwara na ozi ịntanetị i debanyere.

ariaToggleSpeaker.translation: Gbanye ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ igwe nkwuputa ụda

ariaSeverityScale.translation: Ogo ịdị njọ site na 1 ruo 10

ariaInviteLink.translation: Njikọ ma ọ bụ koodu ịkpọ òkù

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact
callSummaryDeclinedLogged.translation: A jụrụ oku · e dekọọla na enweghị mkparịta ụka

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact
callSummaryEndedLogged.translation: Oku agwụla · e dekọọla na enweghị mkparịta ụka

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Tinye njikọ ịkpọ òkù ụlọ ọgwụ gị zitere, ma ọ bụ jiri igwefoto gụọ koodu QR ha.

inviteInputLabel.translation: Njikọ ma ọ bụ koodu ịkpọ òkù

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Nke ahụ adịghị ka njikọ ma ọ bụ koodu ịkpọ òkù Triavi.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code
inviteScanSubtitle.translation: Tụnye igwefoto gị n'ebe koodu dị

inviteEnterManually.translation: Dee njikọ ịkpọ òkù n'onwe gị

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Koodu ụlọ ọgwụ ziri ezi na-eduga gị ozugbo na nkọwa gị.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Koodu ụlọ ọgwụ ziri ezi na-eduga gị na nkọwa gị. Nnwale: pịa ihe atụ koodu achọtara ka ị nwaa ụzọ ahụ.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Nye ikike igwefoto na ntọala nchọgharị gị, ma ọ bụ dee njikọ ịkpọ òkù n'onwe gị.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Ahụghị igwefoto. Tinye njikọ ịkpọ òkù ụlọ ọgwụ gị zitere.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Igwefoto adịghị ugbu a. Dee njikọ ịkpọ òkù n'onwe gị.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Enweghị ịntanetị · a na-egosi ajụjụ echekwara

questionContext.en: Were you resting or active when it began?
questionContext.translation: Ị nọ na-ezu ike ma ọ bụ na-arụ ọrụ mgbe ọ malitere?

questionSeverity.en: How strong is the discomfort right now?
questionSeverity.translation: Kedu ka mgbu ma ọ bụ ahụ erughị ala si dị ugbu a?

questionRadiation.translation: Mgbu ahụ ọ na-agbasa ebe ọzọ?

questionAssociated.en: Are you noticing any of these as well?
questionAssociated.translation: Ị na-ahụkwa nke ọ bụla n'ime ndị a?

choiceYesterday.translation: Ụnyaahụ ma ọ bụ tupu ya

followupPain.en: How is your pain compared to when you were discharged?
followupPain.translation: Kedu ka mgbu gị dị ma e jiri ya tụnyere mgbe ị hapụrụ ụlọ ọgwụ?

followupMeds.en: Have you been taking your medications as prescribed?
followupMeds.translation: Ị na-aṅụ ọgwụ gị dịka e nyere gị ntụziaka?

followupFever.en: Do you still have a fever?

followupEating.en: Are you able to eat and drink normally?
followupEating.translation: Ị nwere ike iri nri ma ṅụọ ihe dịka ị na-emebu?

choiceMildEffort.translation: Ọ dị ntakịrị — naanị mgbe m na-agbalịsi ike

choiceYesRest.translation: Ee — ọbụna mgbe m na-ezu ike

choiceNormalBreath.translation: Ee, ana m eku ume nke ọma

choiceHardBreath.translation: Ọ na-esiri m ike iku ume

choiceLessFood.translation: Ana m eri obere karịa mbụ

choiceNoFluids.translation: Ana m agbọ ihe m ṅụrụ

questionLocation.en: Where do you feel the symptoms?
questionLocation.translation: Ebee n'ahụ ka ị na-enwe mgbaàmà?

questionModifiers.en: What makes the symptoms better or worse?
questionModifiers.translation: Gịnị na-eme ka mgbaàmà dị mma ma ọ bụ njọ?

questionReady.en: Your answers are ready for review.
questionReady.translation: Azịza gị dị njikere maka nyocha.

errRequest.en: We could not complete your request. Please try again.
errRequest.translation: Anyị enweghị ike imezu arịrịọ gị. Biko nwaa ọzọ.

demoOnset.translation: Ihe dị ka awa 1–3 gara aga, mgbe m na-ezu ike

questionDuration.en: How long have you had this?
questionDuration.translation: Ogologo oge ole ka i nwere nke a?

questionCharacter.en: How would you describe the quality of the discomfort?
questionCharacter.translation: Kedu ka ị ga-esi kọwaa ụdị mgbu ma ọ bụ ahụ erughị ala ahụ?

questionAggravating.translation: Gịnị na-eme ka ọ kawanye njọ?

questionRelieving.translation: Gịnị na-eme ka ọ ka mma?

questionMedications.en: What medications are you currently taking?
questionMedications.translation: Kedu ọgwụ ị na-aṅụ ugbu a?

questionAllergies.translation: Ị nwere ihe ahụ gị anaghị anabata, dịka ọgwụ ma ọ bụ nri?

questionHistory.en: Any relevant medical history I should know about?
questionHistory.translation: Ọ dị akụkọ ahụike dị mkpa m kwesịrị ịma?

questionRedFlags.en: Are you experiencing any severe or alarming symptoms?
questionRedFlags.translation: Ị nwere mgbaàmà siri ike ma ọ bụ na-enye gị nchegbu?

questionSeverityScale.en: How strong is the discomfort right now, from 0 to 10?
questionSeverityScale.translation: Site na 0 ruo 10, kedu ka mgbu ma ọ bụ ahụ erughị ala ahụ siri dị ugbu a?

callBackHour.en: We'll call you back in 1 hour · {hospital}
callBackHour.translation: Anyị ga-akpọ gị ọzọ n'ime awa 1 · {hospital}

demoCallGreeting.translation: Nnọọ {name}, ọ bụ {agent} na-akpọ site na {hospital}.

demoCallEvening.en: I'm calling to remind you about your evening dose of {med}.
demoCallEvening.translation: Ana m akpọ iji chetara gị ọgwụ mgbede gị, {med}.

demoCallDue.en: It's 8 o'clock — time for your {med}. Have you taken it yet?
demoCallDue.translation: Ọ bụ elekere 8 — oge {med} gị eruola. Ị ṅụọla ya?
